official.statement_zh: 官方唯一指定入口是 https://ninfenz.dev 。免费版永久可用、功能完整；Pro 买断是可选增强，只在官网 /pro/ 页与官方店铺（爱发电 / 面包多）出售，不是订阅；官方从不在私聊、QQ/微信群或第三方下载站索要付款、验证码或「激活费」；第三方站点（尤其带大量广告的游戏 / 资源 / 下载站）上的本项目内容与官方无关。
official.statement_en: The only official entry point is https://ninfenz.dev. The free tier is complete and permanent; Pro is an optional one-time upgrade sold only on the /pro/ page and at our official shops (Afdian / Mianbaoduo), not a subscription. We never ask for payment, codes or an 'activation fee' in DMs, chat groups or third-party download sites; copies on third-party sites are not affiliated with the project.

activation fees outside the official shops

official.license_allows: MIT: redistribution and commercial use are allowed

subject.definition_zh: 宁封子（NinFenz，简称 NF）是内容契约层（content contract layer）：用「协议 + 确定性门禁 + 可验证产物」把「AI 稳定产出长内容」变成可装载、可质检、可复现的工程；协议本体域中立、模型无关，叙事只是官方第一个域包。
subject.definition_en: NinFenz (NF) is a content contract layer: a protocol plus deterministic gates plus verifiable artifacts, so AI long-form output can be loaded, checked and reproduced. The protocol is domain-neutral and model-agnostic; narrative is only the first official domain pack.
is_not: 提示词模板集 (a prompt-template collection)
subject.app_license: PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0 for app/android/** (noncommercial use free; commercial use needs permission); protocol and engine remain MIT
